+func TestCheckerTokenEvents(t *testing.T) {
+	testCases := []struct {
+		name    string
+		events  []string
+		created bool
+		deleted bool
+	}{
+		{name: "created", events: []string{"token:created"}, created: true},
+		{name: "deleted", events: []string{"token:deleted"}, deleted: true},
+		{name: "token wildcard", events: []string{"token:*"}, created: true, deleted: true},
+		{name: "deleted wildcard", events: []string{"*:deleted"}, deleted: true},
+		{name: "all events", events: []string{"*:*"}, created: true, deleted: true},
+		{name: "other resource", events: []string{"flag:deleted"}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tc := range testCases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			checker, err := NewChecker(tc.events)
+			assert.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tc.created, checker.Check("token:created"))
+			assert.Equal(t, tc.deleted, checker.Check("token:deleted"))
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestDeleteAuthenticationAuditEvent(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		method  rpcauth.Method
+		enabled bool
+		want    bool
+	}{
+		{name: "enabled token", method: rpcauth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN, enabled: true, want: true},
+		{name: "disabled token", method: rpcauth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{name: "enabled other method", method: rpcauth.Method_METHOD_OIDC, enabled: true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			store := memory.NewStore()
+			_, authentication, err := store.CreateAuthentication(ctx, &storageauth.CreateAuthenticationRequest{Method: tc.method})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			recorder := tracetest.NewSpanRecorder()
+			provider := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithSpanProcessor(recorder))
+			defer provider.Shutdown(ctx)
+			ctx, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(ctx, "delete authentication")
+
+			server := auth.NewServer(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, auth.WithAuditLoggingEnabled(tc.enabled))
+			_, err = server.DeleteAuthentication(ctx, &rpcauth.DeleteAuthenticationRequest{Id: authentication.Id})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			span.End()
+
+			spans := recorder.Ended()
+			require.Len(t, spans, 1)
+			events := spans[0].Events()
+			if !tc.want {
+				require.Empty(t, events)
+				return
+			}
+
+			require.Len(t, events, 1)
+			require.Contains(t, events[0].Attributes, attribute.String("flipt.event.type", "token"))
+			require.Contains(t, events[0].Attributes, attribute.String("flipt.event.action", "deleted"))
+		})
+	}
+}
